shared_elements: dense horizontal band(s)/registers of inscription signs
symmetrical pair of figures facing inward toward a central element
small repeated signs arranged in ruled lines
justification: Both surfaces combine dense ruled bands of script with a mirror-symmetrical pair of profile human figures turned inward toward a central vertical feature, which is a genuine, non-trivial compositional correspondence. But the depicted content differs sharply: A is overwhelmingly a text field with two tiny schematic kneeling figures tucked into the lower corners, while B is dominated by two large, muscular winged anthropomorphic figures with elaborate wings, beards and bracelets flanking a stylised tree with rosettes and palmettes, the inscription reduced to a single basal band.
